title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - DataAccessPrerequisite
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/DataAccessPrerequisite. A condition that the Data Consumer must fulfill to be given access to an instance of the data sets.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'DataAccessPrerequisite'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

dataAccessPolicy.description: Property. A text expressing a specific condition applicable (ODRL recommended); may also be a resolvable URI.

permissibleEvidences.description: Relationship. Evidence to demonstrate that a policy is fulfilled. Links to an EvidenceTemplate entity.
